args.description: Write a short thank-you note for a neighbour

messages.content:
Here are a few options, depending on the situation:

**Option 1: General & Friendly (Best for a small favor)**
> "Hi [Name], I just wanted to send a quick note to say thank you for [mention the favor, e.g., picking up my mail / watching my dog]. It was a huge help! I really appreciate it. Best, [Your Name]"

**Option 2: For a Gift or Treat**
> "Hi [Name], thank you so much for the [gift/treat]! It was so kind of you to think of me. I really appreciate your kindness. Best, [Your Name]"

**Option 3: Short & Sweet**
> "Hi [Name], thanks for being such a great neighbor! I really appreciate you. Best, [Your Name]"
